title: Lohith steers and judges outcomes
summary: Assume Lohith returns with no context. State goal, current checkpoint and next action briefly. Save feedback and decisions immediately; show concrete results for his judgment. Do not turn questions into changes or technical success into acceptance.
body:
Keep progress updates short and regular. Explain any verification by its input, expected behavior, observed result and limitation. The user need not memorize commands or maintain records manually. If either partner drifts, show the connection to the project and agree whether to change course.
Presentation clarification, 2026-09-26: Lohith rejected the expandable HTML map as inaccessible and the short diagram as incomplete. When explaining the whole plan, present all segments, actor responsibilities (Python/Jev/writer/human), decisions, unknown/failure handling and unresolved choices directly in chat, using numbered short blocks and readable tables. Do not hide essential detail behind expansion controls or replace the complete explanation with an overview. Do not invent new requirements while restating the plan.
change_reason: Record explicit feedback: full plan must be accessible in chat, not buried in HTML or oversimplified
